quality.issue: Rows with neither speed nor RPM

findings.finding: Each vehicle type records a different set of signals; no trip has all of them
findings.decision: One detector per subsystem; the report lists skipped checks

findings.finding: Fuel trim coverage jumped from about 15% to 70-90% of trips after the first week
findings.decision: Train on several weeks; the included model (week 1 only) is conservative for fuel faults

findings.finding: Usual fuel trim and battery voltage differ widely between vehicles
findings.decision: Per-vehicle baselines; features measure deviation from them

findings.finding: Airflow is about constant x RPM x load per engine; voltage is about linear in charge and current
findings.decision: Physics-based residuals for the air and battery checks
Fine for fuel trims and voltage; misfire detection is limited
